query:
SELECT CASE WHEN $2
                  THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounting_periods
                               WHERE workspace_id = $1 AND start_date < $4 AND $3 < end_date)
                  ELSE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounting_fiscal_years
                               WHERE workspace_id = $1 AND start_date < $4 AND $3 < end_date)
                  END AS "o!"
